rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for the standard brass instrument.

example.english: I learned to play the trumpet when I was young.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sai3 go3 hok6 gwo3 siu2 hou6

rows.note: Use this for a person whose instrument is the trumpet.

example.english: He is the band's trumpet player.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngok6 deoi6 ge3 siu2 hou6 sau2

rows.note: Use this for the cry or trumpeting sound specifically made by an elephant.

example.english: The elephant's trumpet is really loud.
example.traditional: 大象嘅叫聲真係好大聲。
example.jyutping: daai6 zoeng6 ge3 giu3 sing1 zan1 hai6 hou2 daai6 seng1

rows.note: Use this for the loud roar-like part of the sense, including a similar loud cry rather than a neutral animal call.

example.english: A loud roar like a trumpet suddenly came from the bar.
example.traditional: 隔籬間酒吧突然傳出吼聲。
example.jyutping: gaak3 lei4 gaan1 zau2 baa1 dat6 jin4 cyun4 ceot1 hau2 sing1
